Test Anovra backend flows from authentication to role dashboards.

Use the Authorize button to test with Supabase session tokens or live vendor API keys (ak_live_...). Covers customer, vendor, Brand HQ, branch, admin, Edge Functions, and developer endpoints.

1. Auth flows Use Supabase Auth endpoints for customer, vendor, Brand HQ, branch, staff, and admin sign-in.
2. Dashboard data Use REST table endpoints with RLS-backed session tokens.
3. Developer API Use generated ak_live_... keys for external vendor integrations.
